name: plan-only-payload-shape
title: Plan-only and executed local-review reports have divergent payload shapes
description: sd-ai-command-pack-review-local.py emits two structurally different payloads under one command name: --plan-only puts plan and target at the JSON root, while an executed run nests plan, target and attempts under .receipt and keeps only command, outcome, status, run and remoteSummary at the root. No field present in both identifies the shape, and jq paths written for one silently return null against the other.
creator: sdelmas
